Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 4
Reason for Mistake: The Planner misinterpreted the royal succession, assuming Sobhuza I’s predecessor (Ngwane III) was his father, despite sources clearly stating Sobhuza I’s father was Ndvungunye (Zikodze). This failure to synthesize and verify evidence led to the incorrect intermediate conclusion (Ngwane III) before later correction.
